controls.regle: Each application repository carries an operational README describing the project's purpose, prerequisites, start/test/deployment commands and points of contact, kept up to date with each structural change.
controls.verification: Verify the presence and completeness of the README (purpose, prerequisites, essential commands, contacts) and its consistency with the actual state of the project.
controls.preuve_attendue: README content + verification that the documented commands actually execute.
controls.grille_verdict: compliant = complete, up-to-date README, commands verified functional ; partial = README present but incomplete or partially outdated ; non-compliant = README absent or reduced to a title
actions_audit: Verify the presence of the expected README sections (purpose, prerequisites, startup, deployment, contacts).
Execute the documented commands and verify their success.
If gap: complete the missing sections and correct the outdated commands.

controls.regle: Every exposed API publishes an explicit interface contract (e.g. open specification), versioned, synchronized with the actual implementation and automatically verified in continuous integration.
controls.verification: Verify the publication of an interface contract for each exposed API, its explicit versioning, and the existence of an automated contract/implementation compliance check in CI.
controls.preuve_attendue: Published and versioned interface contract + contract/implementation compliance report generated by the pipeline.
controls.grille_verdict: compliant = contract published, versioned and automatically verified in CI ; partial = contract published but not automatically verified ; non-compliant = absence of an explicit interface contract
actions_audit: Verify the publication and versioning of the interface contract for each exposed API.
Verify the execution of an automated contract/implementation compliance check in CI.
If gap: publish the missing contract and tool the automated verification.

controls.regle: Significant architecture decisions are recorded in an active decision register (ADR): each decision carries an identifier and a frontmatter compliant with the corpus schema, and no decision with accepted status is substantively rewritten outside of a status change or an explicit succession link.
controls.verification: Verify that the decision register covers recent structural choices, that each entry complies with the expected identifier and frontmatter schema, and that no accepted entry has been substantively modified without the creation of a replacement decision.
controls.preuve_attendue: Extract from the decision register + output from the format checker + version history demonstrating the absence of rewriting of an accepted decision.
controls.grille_verdict: compliant = active register, 0 format anomalies, no substantive rewriting detected ; partial = active register with minor anomalies or missing decisions on recent choices ; non-compliant = register absent or accepted decision rewritten without traceability
actions_audit: Verify the decision register's coverage against the structural choices identified in D01.
Run the format checker on the register and note the anomalies.
If gap: complete the register for the missing decisions and correct the format anomalies.
standards: MADR 4.0.0 (gabarit et cycle de vie des décisions)

controls.regle: Technical architecture documentation (diagrams, adopted principles, register of gaps relative to the target) is kept up to date and accessible to all the teams concerned.
controls.verification: Verify the existence and freshness of the technical architecture documentation and the register of gaps relative to the documented target architecture.
controls.preuve_attendue: Technical architecture diagrams and documents + register of gaps with remediation status.
controls.grille_verdict: compliant = up-to-date documentation and gap register maintained, all justified ; partial = documentation present but partially outdated or not all gaps justified ; non-compliant = absence of technical architecture documentation or gap register
actions_audit: Compare the technical architecture documentation to the actual implementation and note the discrepancies.
Verify that every gap appears in the register with a remediation status.
If gap: update the documentation and complete the gap register.
standards: TOGAF ADM — Phase G (gouvernance de la mise en œuvre)

controls.regle: User documentation covering the main features is published, accessible from the application or its associated portal, and kept up to date with delivered functional changes.
controls.verification: Verify the existence, accessibility and freshness of the user documentation with regard to the main features delivered.
controls.preuve_attendue: Extract from the user documentation (last update date, functional coverage) + access verified from the application.
controls.grille_verdict: compliant = user documentation accessible and up to date across all main features ; partial = partial or outdated documentation ; non-compliant = absence of user documentation
actions_audit: Verify the user documentation's coverage against the declared main features.
Verify the accessibility of the documentation from the application or its associated portal.
If gap: complete or update the missing user documentation.

controls.regle: An onboarding guide enables a new developer to obtain a functional environment and make their first contribution autonomously, without systematically needing help from the existing team.
controls.verification: Have the onboarding guide followed by a person who has never worked on the project and measure the time and number of requests for help needed to obtain a functional environment.
controls.preuve_attendue: Documented onboarding guide + report of a test onboarding (duration, help requests needed).
controls.grille_verdict: compliant = functional environment obtained autonomously in less than one day ; partial = onboarding achievable with a few occasional requests for help ; non-compliant = onboarding impossible without continuous team assistance
actions_audit: Have the onboarding guide followed by a person outside the project and time the result.
Note the blocking points that required a request for help from the existing team.
If gap: complete the guide on the identified blocking points.

controls.regle: A data dictionary describing entities, attributes and business meanings is published in a referenced catalog, discoverable and searchable by business meaning rather than by technical structure alone.
controls.verification: Verify the publication of a data dictionary in a referenced catalog, its coverage of the entities in production, and the possibility of searching it by business meaning.
controls.preuve_attendue: Extract from the data catalog showing the coverage and freshness of the dictionary's descriptions.
controls.grille_verdict: compliant = dictionary published, up to date, covering all entities in production and searchable by business meaning ; partial = incomplete coverage or search by business meaning absent ; non-compliant = absence of a referenced data dictionary
actions_audit: Verify the data dictionary's coverage against the entities in production.
Test the search for an entity by its business meaning in the catalog.
If gap: complete the dictionary and publish the missing entities in the referenced catalog.

controls.regle: Applicable compliance documentation (impact assessments, register of processing activities, regulatory classifications, control evidence) is centralized, referenced from the project documentation and kept up to date with each significant change.
controls.verification: Verify the existence and accessibility of the applicable compliance documentation, its reference from the project documentation, and its update following the last significant change.
controls.preuve_attendue: Inventory of the applicable compliance documentation + proof of update following the project's last significant change.
controls.grille_verdict: compliant = compliance documentation complete, referenced and up to date ; partial = documentation existing but not referenced or partially outdated ; non-compliant = compliance documentation absent for an applicable obligation
actions_audit: List the applicable compliance obligations and verify the existence of the corresponding documentation.
Verify the reference to this documentation from the project documentation and its last update date.
If gap: produce the missing documentation and establish its update process.
standards: ISO/IEC 27002:2022 — 5.36 (conformité aux politiques, règles et normes)
RGPD — art. 30 (registre des activités de traitement)

controls.regle: All project documentation (README, API doc, technical doc, ADR) is versioned in the same repository or a linked repository, reviewed via a change proposal like the code, and automatically published with each accepted change.
controls.verification: Verify that the documentation is versioned under source control, reviewed through a change proposal mechanism, and automatically published after merging, with a synchronization timestamp.
controls.preuve_attendue: Documentation version history + automated publishing configuration + timestamp of the last synchronization.
controls.grille_verdict: compliant = documentation versioned, systematic review, publication synchronized in under 24 hours ; partial = versioned and reviewed but manual publication or documented latency ; non-compliant = documentation not versioned or edited outside the review flow
actions_audit: Verify that the documentation is stored under version control and goes through a review before merging.
Verify the configuration and freshness of the documentation's automated publishing.
If gap: migrate the remaining documentation to the versioned repository and tool the automatic publishing.
